accounts.name: What changed and why it matters

queue.headline: $PEG just lined up a pattern we track.
queue.body: Across every name we test it on, this combination has resolved higher 72% of the time about a month out over its full tested history, over 181 occurrences universe-wide, not this one name. A measured tendency on a study split, not our trading record. Chart below.

accounts.name: Founder's desk — the day's tape, first person

queue.body: $AVNT three straight red days into the volume shelf. I'm watching 37.1.

Jobless claims averaging 203k this month, 8.6% below a year ago.
Atlanta Fed GDPNow has this quarter at a 5.0% annual rate.
Labor market not cracking and now growth is accelerating into it. If you were waiting for the data to force the Fed's hand lower, this is not that.
